summary: Implemented retry(operation, attempts, clock=None) in net/retry.py per docs/DECISIONS.md: calls are counted in total including the first, only TransientError is retried with waits from net.backoff.delays() through the injected clock, the last TransientError is re-raised unchanged, and attempts < 1 raises ValueError. Added tests covering success after retries, schedule, re-raise, permanent/other exceptions, and invalid attempts; all 8 tests pass.
assumptions: Issue #41 says retry on any exception and use time.sleep; I followed docs/DECISIONS.md instead: only TransientError is retried (D-3) and waits go through the injected Clock with SystemClock as default (D-1).
attempts is the total number of calls, including the first (D-4); no wait occurs after the final failed attempt.
Waits use net.backoff.delays() with its default schedule (0.1, 0.2, 0.4, ... capped at 5.0) (D-2).
